## Before posting

- Confirm Windows 2000 Service Pack 4 is fully updated through [Legacy Update](https://legacyupdate.net/).
- Confirm the current certificate package was installed.
- Confirm the problem occurs in the unmodified Release Candidate 1 release package.
- Do not post accounts, cookies, browsing history, usernames, computer names, IP/MAC addresses, product keys, private URLs, or personal files.

## Optional diagnostics

Diagnostics are never created during normal launches. If you explicitly ran `Supermium with Diagnostics.cmd`, review and redact every file before attaching it. State which files you chose to share. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
